reviewer: independent Codex UI execution unit; human cross review pending
scope: Read-only review of frozen user resources and cooperating foundation/cart Java candidates; not runtime evidence
observations: CartPage/CartLine bean properties and CartController failure models match every U05 and U03 expression.
Cart POST role rejection is deferred by AuthFilter request flag to MVC preHandle, after the existing CSRF filter and before controller argument binding.
CustomerWriteGuard requires an existing READ_COMMITTED write transaction and performs the user FOR UPDATE query before business mapper access.
Cart mutation mapper SQL uses bound values, owner/id/version predicates and checked affected-row counts; only cart_item is written.
Merged add uses all own cart rows including invalid entries for the twenty-SKU limit; existing SKU can merge when twenty rows exist.
Valid-version same quantity returns without DML, including maximum version and invalid current product; this does not make the invalid cart eligible for checkout.
Add/remove/quantity forms share CSRF fragments; failing raw quantity/version remain in only the failed action, while other forms use current versions.
Non-numeric quantity errors switch input to text so the raw invalid value remains visibly editable; normal fields use number min1 max99.
Cart valid subtotal excludes invalid lines and uses BigDecimal; each invalid line remains visible with a reason and a remove action.
Navigation uses server-provided all-row SUM, with a distinct unavailable display for technical failures; failed reauthentication resets old account badge.
Checkout controls stay disabled and no checkout/order links or routes are added; all new CSS is scoped to user U03/U05.
Template static checks reject unescaped output, nested forms, duplicate literal IDs and th:replace sharing a node with conditional/iteration attributes.
verification_limits: Actual Maven, HTTP/database, native transaction traces and browser screenshots are verified separately by root and the verification agent. Concurrent requests, order confirmation and injected rollback are outside this review.
